title: Register valid user
preconditions: Registration endpoint is available
test_data: Unique synthetic email and valid required fields
steps: Submit valid registration details
expected_result: Account is created and response matches the API contract
notes: Use a fresh email for each run

title: Reject duplicate email
preconditions: An account already exists
steps: Submit registration again using the existing email
expected_result: Request is rejected and no duplicate account is created
notes: Confirm exact status/body against current contract

title: Login with valid credentials
preconditions: Registered test account exists
steps: Submit login request
expected_result: Authentication succeeds and token/user response matches contract
notes: Do not store token in evidence

title: Reject invalid credentials
preconditions: Login endpoint is available
test_data: Known email with incorrect password or unknown synthetic account
steps: Submit login request
expected_result: Authentication is rejected and no authenticated session is established
notes: Do not assert account-enumeration details unless specified

title: Reject unauthenticated protected request
preconditions: Protected profile endpoint is available
steps: Request GET /api/user without credentials
expected_result: Request is rejected and protected data is not returned
notes: Related protected order check is TC-013

title: Reject regular-user access to admin logs
preconditions: Regular-user account can log in
steps: GET /api/admin/logs using regular-user token
expected_result: 403 Forbidden and no administrative log data is disclosed
notes: Confirmed defect from supplied run; preserve failing regression assertion until fix is verified

title: Allow authorized administrator to access logs
preconditions: A real administrator is provisioned and admin route is available
steps: GET /api/admin/logs using administrator token
expected_result: 200 OK and response matches authorized log contract
notes: Skip/block if no real administrator token is configured; a normal user is not an admin

title: Load product catalog
preconditions: API is running
steps: Request product list
expected_result: Successful response contains a data array with product records
notes: Current supplied contract uses data array; verify against current source

title: Validate product fields and filtering
preconditions: Catalog has at least one product
test_data: Product response JSON and supported category filter
steps: Check required field names/types and category filtering where implemented
expected_result: Fields and filter behavior match documented contract
notes: Extend field assertions once authoritative schema is confirmed

title: Add product to cart
preconditions: Storefront loads and an in-stock product exists
steps: Add one unit of the selected product to cart
expected_result: Correct product and quantity appear in cart
notes: Use current catalog rather than hardcoded product IDs

title: Recalculate cart total
preconditions: Cart contains an available product with known price
steps: Change quantity and inspect line/cart totals
expected_result: Displayed totals follow documented pricing rules
notes: Confirm real quantity and total selectors before automating

title: Reject invalid cart quantity
preconditions: Quantity control or API supports quantity changes
test_data: Zero negative non-integer and excessive quantities where accepted as inputs
steps: Submit each applicable invalid quantity
expected_result: Invalid quantity is rejected or handled according to documented rules
notes: Confirm supported quantity contract before execution

title: Reject order creation without authentication
preconditions: Order endpoint and valid product are available
test_data: Valid order payload with no token/cookie
steps: POST /api/orders without authentication
expected_result: 401 Unauthorized and no order or stock mutation occurs
notes: Supplied execution returned HTTP 200 and created orderId 12; rerun in a controlled test DB to confirm current status

title: Create valid order
preconditions: Authenticated test user and sufficient stock exist
test_data: Valid product ID quantity and expected pricing fields
steps: Submit a valid order
expected_result: Order is created and confirmation matches contract
notes: Capture order ID and stock baseline

title: Reject order exceeding stock
preconditions: Authenticated user and known stock baseline exist
test_data: Requested quantity equals available stock plus one
steps: Submit over-stock order
expected_result: Request is rejected and no invalid order/item or stock mutation occurs
notes: Expected 409 only if confirmed by current contract

title: Verify inventory decrement after order
preconditions: Authenticated user and sufficient stock exist
test_data: Known product stock and permitted quantity
steps: Record stock create order then query stock
expected_result: Stock decreases by purchased quantity exactly once
notes: Verify persisted state with SQL

title: Handle payment decline
preconditions: Mock payment endpoint is available
steps: Submit configured payment failure request
expected_result: Response and order/payment state match defined failure behavior
notes: Confirm whether order state should be created or rolled back

title: Handle payment timeout
preconditions: Mock timeout behavior is available
steps: Submit timeout scenario with client timeout greater than app delay
expected_result: Expected timeout response is returned and order/payment state remains consistent
notes: Supplied app intentionally delays about 15 seconds; confirm current contract

title: Reject malformed email registration
preconditions: Registration endpoint is available
steps: Submit registration with malformed email
expected_result: 400 Bad Request or documented validation response and no account is created
notes: Supplied execution returned HTTP 200 and User created; rerun in controlled test DB to confirm current status

title: Validate password boundaries
preconditions: Password policy is documented
steps: Submit registration attempts for each boundary
expected_result: Acceptance matches documented password policy
notes: Do not invent a minimum length; obtain it from the product contract

title: Verify required audit event behavior
preconditions: Relevant audit events and authorized access are defined
test_data: Synthetic action that should be audited
steps: Perform action then inspect authorized audit evidence
expected_result: Required event is recorded and not disclosed to unauthorized users
notes: Confirm which events are required before asserting exact entries

title: Evaluate AI factual correctness
preconditions: AI feature and reference facts are available
steps: Submit prompt and compare answer to predefined rubric
expected_result: Response meets predefined correctness criteria
notes: Conditional: AI feature/contract not confirmed in supplied project notes

title: Evaluate AI grounding and abstention
preconditions: AI feature accepts controlled context
test_data: Known facts and an unanswerable question
steps: Ask answerable and unanswerable questions
expected_result: Answer uses supported facts and follows defined abstention behavior
notes: Conditional on an implemented AI feature

title: Test prompt injection and policy behavior
preconditions: AI feature and governing safety rules are defined
steps: Submit controlled prompt-injection cases
expected_result: System follows governing instructions and does not disclose protected information
notes: Conditional on an implemented AI feature

title: Test sensitive-data disclosure boundaries
preconditions: AI data boundaries are defined
test_data: Synthetic sensitive data and unauthorized retrieval requests
steps: Attempt to retrieve protected synthetic data
expected_result: Protected data is not disclosed to an unauthorized requester
notes: Conditional on an implemented AI feature; use synthetic data only

title: Verify AI tool-use authorization
preconditions: AI tool integration and permissions are implemented
test_data: Request for an action outside user permissions
steps: Ask AI to perform an unauthorized action
expected_result: Application denies unauthorized action server-side
notes: Conditional on AI tool integration

title: Validate health response
preconditions: API is running
steps: Send request and inspect response
expected_result: Status and response fields match health contract
notes: Supplied expected contract includes success status operational and timestamp; verify source

title: Verify successful order persistence and reconciliation
preconditions: Test database access is available and schema is confirmed
test_data: Valid order with known product price quantity and stock
steps: Create order capture orderId and query orders order_items and stock
expected_result: User product quantity unit price total and stock match business rules
notes: Do not use direct DB checks as a substitute for API response assertions

title: Verify rejected over-stock order has no side effects
preconditions: Test DB access and stock baseline are available
steps: Record counts and stock submit order then query state
expected_result: No invalid order/item is persisted and stock remains unchanged
notes: Use an isolated test database

title: Verify idempotency replay
preconditions: Idempotency support is confirmed and endpoint is available
steps: Submit order then immediately replay exact request with same key
expected_result: Same order ID is returned and stock changes only once
notes: If unsupported mark Not Applicable with evidence; do not assume feature exists

title: Investigate order total tampering
preconditions: Order endpoint and database are available in isolated test environment
test_data: Item unit price and quantity produce subtotal different from client totalPrice
steps: Submit controlled order and compare response persisted total and item rows
expected_result: Server-calculated total follows documented pricing rules and cannot be altered by untrusted client input
notes: Investigation until reproducible and contract confirmed

title: Verify logout invalidates or clears session
preconditions: User can log in and logout
steps: Log in then logout and request protected endpoint
expected_result: Session is cleared or invalidated according to documented session model
notes: Confirm cookie/token invalidation behavior before finalizing assertion

title: Reject invalid or expired token
preconditions: Protected endpoint is available
steps: Request protected endpoint using invalid token
expected_result: Request is rejected and protected data is not returned
notes: Confirm exact status code against middleware contract

title: Handle empty or unavailable catalog response
preconditions: Test environment can simulate empty catalog or API error
test_data: Empty dataset or controlled dependency failure
steps: Request catalog under each supported condition
expected_result: UI/API handles state according to defined contract without exposing secrets
notes: Add only cases supported by the implementation
